# Entra App Registration — OAuth & MSAL Guide

💳 Paid Azure subscription required — Curated by Skill Harbor — Microsoft's end-to-end guide to Microsoft Entra ID app registrations: the core concepts (application ID, tenant ID, redirect URIs, service principals), step-by-step registration via portal, CLI or Bicep/IaC, API permission configuration, client secrets vs certificates vs federated credentials, and OAuth 2.0 flow implementation with MSAL for .NET, JavaScript and Python — wrapped in explicit security best practices (never hardcode secrets, least-privilege permissions, managed identity preferred, token validation). By @microsoft, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: this skill deals with identity credentials — follow its Key Vault/managed-identity guidance strictly and rotate any client secret you create; a misconfigured redirect URI or over-broad API permission is a real security hole. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
